capabilities: Format selected links into an unordered Markdown list
Run the formatting command from the command palette
Bind the command to a hotkey
extras: Installation via BRAT is documented, suggesting beta distribution; all instructions are installation-focused with only one usage step.
problem: Pasting links such as Firefox bookmarks into a note leaves an unformatted block that must be manually rewritten into a Markdown list.
summary: Command-based formatter that converts a selected block of pasted links into a clean Markdown unordered list.
